name: 3D Texture Slicing with Back-to-Front Blending
definition: A rendering pipeline that polygonizes volumetric geometry into slices parallel to the viewport, sorts them back-to-front, and blends them using the over operator to composite the volume.
summary: This method renders volumes by polygonizing geometry into viewport-parallel slices, sorting them back-to-front, and compositing them via the over operator, distinguished by its reliance on explicit application-side visibility sorting.
